authority.allocation_observability: allocation.nc records explicitly verified at t=0 and t=24 h

qualified_claims: The actual pinned RibaMod passive-Drainage route reproduces the preregistered DUMMY-20F2 day-1 accepted-state prefix through t=24 h.
Current positive groundwater drainage of approximately 7.9998720020 m3/day is physically active at the t=24 management boundary.
Actual Ribasim allocation output contains distinct t=0 and t=24 records and records 40/20 m3/day at t=24.

The observed t=24 external allocation is materially above the preregistered memory-only alternative 13.9748888743 m3/day, so current positive groundwater forcing is admitted in addition to accepted physical memory.
External physical supply remains zero through the t=24 accepted state and becomes positive only in the first post-boundary segment, preserving solve/apply/realize ordering.
The coupled source plus groundwater equals UserDemand plus Basin-storage ledger closes at all observed boundaries to reported numerical precision.

coupling_contract.accepted_memory: Positive groundwater received during day 1 changes accepted Basin state and persists into the t=24 management boundary.
coupling_contract.current_positive_forcing: The contemporaneous Basin drainage term is explicit positive forecast supply and is admitted in the t=24 allocation in addition to accepted storage memory.
coupling_contract.allocation_decision: The resulting t=24 managed allocation is full root 40 plus external 20 m3/day.
coupling_contract.realization: The t=24 allocation governs subsequent physical realization and does not retroactively alter the accepted day-1 state.

sign_pair_with_h7_h8.negative_direction: Current Basin infiltration is implicit negative forcing and can be attenuated by low_storage_factor=0 while accepted memory remains admitted.
sign_pair_with_h7_h8.positive_direction: Current Basin drainage is explicit positive forcing and is admitted directly alongside accepted memory.
sign_pair_with_h7_h8.implication: The product management forecast is direction-sensitive even though physical exchange itself remains reciprocally mass-conservative.

boundaries: This result applies to the tested passive-Drainage topology and exact pinned product versions.
No claim that every positive Ribasim forcing or arbitrary network has identical allocation semantics.
No implicit same-window groundwater-surface-water fixed point is established.
No production SWAP5 admission, storage-partition decision or drainage-ownership decision.
downstream: Treat H7-H9 as the closed sign-sensitive accepted-memory/current-forcing product contract. Next work should test asynchronous allocation-boundary timing or topology/priority dependence rather than re-proving this same aligned single-Basin case.
